identity: Possible misidentification of Double Concerto for alto saxophone, piano and orchestra
findings: Billaudot's Double Concerto is a 27-minute work with alto saxophone and piano as soloists, orchestra including harp and three percussionists. This conflicts with the catalog's soprano saxophone listing.
CiNii describes an Éditions françaises de musique score copyrighted 1969, 97 pages. This is a publication date, not verified composition date.
University of Iowa program notes distinguish Dialogue Symphonique from the earlier double concerto, so the generic Concerto title needs confirmation.
